scope: Read-only independent source/spec review and external synthetic offline acceptance probes; no author-tree edits, remote actions, full-suite duplication or live/native qualification.

reviewed_contracts: Active source catalogue; unreadable sources refuse without reviving superseded products.
Full ProductScope identity and complete SourceDoc snapshot admission; one admitted index for validation and provenance.
Actual pair Lead, selected scope, stored coverage and append-only analyst decision; no CVE/card/CWE/hypothesis inference.
Existing pair hash, component, architecture, destination and revision CAS checks retained.
Product-specific repair uses exact journaled source set and complete selected_product equality before attach writes.
UI explicit selection, generation invalidation, mode separation, network-grant revocation and cancellation retention.

initial_run.resolution: Unreadable catalogue returns PT-KBC-VERIFY; PT-KBC-STALE is the admission error. The external probe was corrected to expect VERIFY. Production code was unchanged.

static_checks.schema_drift: No public model/schema or SQL version files changed; author separately reports schema generation has no drift.

author_reported_validation.attribution: Reported by candidate_review; independent result above is separate.

legacy_reader_boundary.persisted_change: Optional selected_product member in internal attach-journal JSON. This is a persisted journal-format addition despite unchanged public schemas and SQL version.
legacy_reader_boundary.static_verified: Legacy journal_get/journal_ops use json.loads; legacy resume ignores extra keys; legacy _rebuilt_rows ignores selected_product and pair context construction gathers source digests only via CVEs.
legacy_reader_boundary.required_limit: Do not repair a new product-start pending attachment with an older reader. It can report completion while losing product-source context. Use a build implementing the new journal semantics.
legacy_reader_boundary.documentation: SPEC-31-F Local product starting point explicitly records this limitation.

recommended_repository_regressions.distinct_risk: Actual second WorkspaceStore writer wins product_selected CAS; differs from source-import races in authored cases.
Export and reopen must remain self-contained after original workspace source object disappears, not just immediately after creation.
One-row filter and relisting must never auto-select or restore a prior selection; author journey uses multiple products.
Product-mode cancel after real creation completes must report retained project and clear selection without adoption; author late-result controls cover listing only.

optional_small_extension: Parameterize the existing newer-source repair control with a newer advisory that removes the product entirely; the external probe also passes this case.
remaining_coordinator_gates: Combined full suite on integrated head
